citation.authors: Cade WT, Khoury N, Nelson S, et al.
citation.title: Hypoglycemia during moderate intensity exercise reduces counterregulatory responses to subsequent hypoglycemia

reported.what: mean plasma glucose during the first 90-min cycling bout without dextrose infusion (Arm 2, n=9, mean +/- SE), at about 68% of VO2 peak; no VO2 peak or bout uptake is printed

location.where: Results, Day 1 exercise and rest, paragraph 2
location.quote: the subjects remained euglycemic (85 ± 1 mg/dL) during the first bout of exercise with no dextrose infusion

reported.what: percentage of VO2 peak achieved in the first bout, Arm 2

location.quote: in Arm 2 when dextrose was not infused during rest or cycle exercise, subjects exercised at 68 ± 2% VO2 peak during the first bout of exercise

reported.what: mean plasma glucose during the second bout without dextrose, Arm 2 (mean +/- SE)

location.where: Results, Day 1 exercise and rest, paragraph 2
location.quote: The mean plasma glucose during this exercise period was 67 ± 3 mg/dL

detail: The paper gives the bout only as a percentage of each subject's measured VO2 peak and prints neither that peak (mL/kg/min, or absolute with a body weight) nor a work rate nor a measured uptake, so the activity level cannot be derived.
